name: Rhizopus Soft Rot
symptoms: Soft watery rot on infected tissues Rapid breakdown of fruit or vegetable tissue White cotton-like fungal growth on the surface Black pin-like spore structures on infected areas Foul smell in advanced decay Infected tissues become mushy and collapse
description: Rhizopus soft rot is a fungal disease that mainly affects fruits, vegetables, and stored crops. The fungus infects wounded plant tissues and causes a rapid soft, watery decay. It is common during storage, transport, and in warm and humid conditions.
management: Handle fruits and vegetables carefully to avoid wounds Harvest crops during dry conditions Remove damaged or infected produce quickly Maintain good hygiene in storage areas Ensure proper ventilation in storage facilities
prevention: Avoid mechanical injuries during harvest Store crops at appropriate temperature and humidity Use clean containers and storage facilities Separate infected produce from healthy produce
